name: Monocular Depth Scale Alignment
definition: A post-optimization step to resolve the up-to-scale problem in 3D scenes reconstructed from multi-view images by aligning the scale of optimized 3D Gaussians with metric-scale monocular depth estimates.
summary: Monocular Depth Scale Alignment is a post-optimization step that fixes Gaussian parameters and optimizes only a global scale factor to resolve up-to-scale ambiguity in 3D Gaussian Splatting.
